name: learn
description: Learn through any code task with meaningfully different options, trade-off explanations, and terminology bridges.

steps.name: Scope
steps.instruction: Read code context. Grep GLOSSARY.md for relevant domain terms. If the task is trivial, just do it - do not force options on a non-decision.

steps.name: Present options
steps.instruction: Present 3 meaningfully different options with code diff previews via AskUserQuestion. Mark recommended option first with '(Recommended)'. Include Terms in play block and Further reading.
checklist: Each option has code diff preview

steps.name: Apply chosen option
steps.instruction: Implement the chosen option. Explain trade-offs of the choice as you build.

steps.name: Reinforce
steps.instruction: Offer Quiz, Practice, or skip via AskUserQuestion (multiSelect). Skip when trivial, user is in a hurry, or concepts already mastered. Save learning notes to docs/_local/learning/.

tone: Brisk. This is a 60-second decision point, not a lecture.
